game_concept: A card battler set in Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater, a breakwater in a storm: the shipwright must handle storm gulls while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater: a breakwater in a storm
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Termination: Use Step to inspect the loop condition. reduce each positive input to zero by subtracting 1 until the condition fails; every procedure must terminate. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 5, operand 16.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Patrol Decision Tree' (Week 3 slot 15), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Storm Breakwater'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.

Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about cover to power up the shipwright and open the lighthouse lamp.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
source_game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Storm Breakwater Streak
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
